headline: Oil −4%, yields and the dollar lower, VIX back to 23, and most megacaps bid offset Nvidia's −5% on the Huang probe. Lean LONG above Friday's settle 27,085; stronger on a hold above the overnight high 27,378. CPI tomorrow caps conviction.
session_note: Cash open 9:30 AM ET (10:30 AM Atlantic) · morning window · Bowman 8:40, Goolsbee 10:00, Barkin 12:15 PM ET · Wholesale inventories 10:00 AM ET · CPI tomorrow 8:30 AM ET

flip.long: LONG stays on while NQ holds above Friday's settle 27,085.25 / overnight midpoint ~27,065. Stronger on a reclaim and hold of the overnight high 27,378 (≈ NDX ~27,283, near Friday's NDX high 27,316). Target 27,500–27,600.
flip.short: Flip SHORT if NQ loses 27,065 (overnight midpoint, just under Friday's settle) and can't reclaim it; next targets ~26,900 then the overnight low 26,751.25.

thesis: A low-conviction lean **LONG** for the open. **NQ is +226 pts / +0.83% at 27,311.25 (≈8:41 AM ET)**, in the upper part of a 26,751.25–27,378.00 overnight range, after Friday's NDX bounce to 26,989.99 [1]. The macro tape is supportive: **WTI is −3.9% at $87.28** on Iran/Hormuz diplomacy, the **10-year is −1.6 bp at 4.84%**, the **dollar is −0.4% at 101.85**, and **VIX has eased to 23.1** [1,4]. Megacaps outside Nvidia are bid premarket (**AMD +4.0%, AMZN +3.3%, AVGO +3.1%, META +3.0%, GOOGL +2.5%, MSFT +2.2%**), while **NVDA is −5.2%** on the board's probe of CEO Jensen Huang [2,3,4]. The case for keeping it small: Dow futures (+1.2%) are leading Nasdaq, December hike odds are still ~78–81% [6,7], and **October CPI lands tomorrow at 8:30 AM ET** [5]. So **lean long above Friday's settle 27,085; flip short below ~27,065**.

bullets.label: Cross-asset is risk-on.
bullets.text: Oil −4% on Iran/Hormuz diplomacy, 10-year −1.6 bp, dollar −0.4%, VIX −10% [1,4]. Lower energy also helps the inflation story a day before CPI.

bullets.label: Breadth beyond Nvidia.
bullets.text: AMD +4% (Oppenheimer upgrade), AMZN, AVGO, META, GOOGL and MSFT all up ~2–3% premarket vs Friday's close [3,4]. Nvidia (−5%) is the one big drag [2,3].

bullets.label: NQ is holding the upper half.
bullets.text: At 27,311 it sits above Friday's settle and the overnight midpoint, ~67 pts under the overnight high 27,378 [1].

bullets.label: Light morning calendar.
bullets.text: No major data before the open; Bowman 8:40, Goolsbee 10:00, Barkin 12:15 PM ET [5,7].

bullets.label: Bear case:
bullets.text: Nasdaq is lagging the Dow, investors are "selective," and Capital Economics says the AI correction could run further [2]. Nvidia leadership uncertainty is unresolved, December hike odds are ~78–81%, and CPI tomorrow invites de-risking into the close [2,6,7].

bullets.label: Bull case:
bullets.text: Bargain hunting after the post-midterm AI rout, falling oil and yields, and broad megacap strength can carry the cash open through the overnight high [2,4].

bullets.label: Stronger LONG:
bullets.text: NQ reclaims and holds 27,378 in the first 30 minutes. Target 27,500–27,600.

bullets.label: Flip to SHORT:
bullets.text: NQ loses ~27,065 (overnight midpoint, just under Friday's settle 27,085) and can't reclaim it. Targets ~26,900, then 26,751.

bullets.label: Go STAND ASIDE:
bullets.text: NQ chops between 27,085 and 27,378 with NVDA dragging and VIX stuck near 23.

bullets.label: Wildcards:
bullets.text: New Nvidia/Huang headlines; hawkish Goolsbee (10:00) or Barkin (12:15); Iran/Hormuz headlines reversing oil; KKR and Constellation Energy earnings [2,5].
